outputs.discrepancies: The caption states the split-GFP assay uses 'a PacL1-GFP11 fusion protein together with GFP1-10 (control) or the indicated proteins fused to GFP11 (first protein) or GFP1-10 (second protein)'. However, the panel's x-axis labels and the statistical reference condition given later in the legend ('(E) PacL2/CtpGMBD') indicate that the tested pair is PacL2 and CtpG (with a PacL2 deletion variant), not PacL1. The protein identity described in the caption (PacL1) does not match what is actually shown/labeled in the panel (PacL2).
